messages.subject: Time recording — January narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Our records show unposted time for January against several matters in your portfolio. Please ensure all narratives are submitted by Wednesday 11 February so we can run the month-end bills. Partners, your pre-bill approvals are also awaited.

Regards
Accounts
